notes.text: You can now define visible and enabled properties for table standard actions via manifest
We now correctly use the active binding context for intent-based navigation after discarding a draft
We've resolved an issue where create:mandatory and update:readonly fields were incorrectly displayed as read-only in tables with creationMode set to inlineCreationRows or EmptyRow
We now correctly hide the Delete button for parameterized entity types
We now avoid redundant action enablement recalculations after a bound action with multiple contexts
We now ensure that cross-application back navigation works correctly in the SAP Build Work Zone iframe
Apps using the flexible column layout now correctly navigate to an object that was recently modified by another user
